setup-code-gaps.text:
What the code needs for these boards:
- Restore code at the end of setup: the bridge already returns it (BridgeStorageSetup.restore_code), but the macOS sheet drops it (SyncSetupWizard.swift connected). bae change.
- Done lands on the Sync page with Restore code on it: bae change. The code can be fetched again any time (generate_restore_code).
- Cancel while setup runs: coven can't stop a setup once it starts. Journaling setup (coven list) makes this Cancel real, and lets a crash resume or undo. coven change, then bae.
- Not synced page, Sync page and their states: bae change, over coven's sync state, as the Sync row's boards and their note show.
- Choose then Continue, and the browser opening on Continue: today each provider is a row that opens its form, and Dropbox and OneDrive wait for Sign in…. bae change.
- S3 row reads “A bucket you manage.” Today the app’s line lists storage services by name (BridgeCloudProvider+Setup.swift:13), Backblaze among them, which setup refuses (coven notes/providers.md). bae change.
- Choose an empty folder: after Set up, setup checks the folder first (Checking the folder…) and, if it holds anything, stops and returns to the list saying so. coven now refuses a Dropbox or OneDrive folder or an S3 bucket that holds anything else (StorageFailure::OwnLocationRequired, coven spec §20.3). bae change: the check before Set up and the words.
- New folder… on Dropbox (makes the folder and shares it): coven can't make and share a Dropbox folder; it calls sharing/share_folder only in its live tests (dropbox_live.rs:122). coven change, then bae.
- One folder picker for Dropbox and OneDrive, the same view on each platform: the list, the empty-folder line, New folder… and its naming row, checking, not empty. Only the provider's facts differ: OneDrive folders open into others (where you are, ›), Dropbox's shared folders are one flat list and a new one is shared. Today macOS keeps one state for both (StorageFolderBrowser.swift) but draws two different lists (OAuthFolderSetup.swift:78-119), and Android has OneDriveBrowser.kt beside ProviderFolderChoice.kt. bae change.
- S3 form: Endpoint, Region, Bucket, the key, in the Sync page's order; no Advanced. Today the form is Bucket, Region, Endpoint, keys (S3SetupForm.swift:43-52), with Profile and Detect settings in Advanced (:55-73); Key prefix is already gone. bae change.
- S3 setup failing: the form comes back as typed. A region that doesn’t match (RegionMismatch) shows under Region, a missing bucket (ContainerNotFound) and a bucket holding other files (OwnLocationRequired) under Bucket; any other failure at the top of the form. Today every failure shows below the fields, above Set up (SyncSetupWizard.swift:286), in the catalog’s more general words (catalog.toml core.error.cloud_setup.*, core.error.category.credentials). bae change.
- An S3 library takes a whole bucket that holds nothing else, as a Dropbox or OneDrive folder must. Built in coven (OwnLocationRequired); key prefixes are gone.
- Everything else, the steps and their words, is what the code does today.
- macOS: every sheet ends in a MacSheetFooter, the one primary button on the right. The code has no shared sheet footer yet. bae change.
- Restore code view (setup's last step, the Sync page, the Restore code page): masked with Copy, plus Show and Hide; shown, the code reads in groups of four (“CVR1 ABCD EFGH …”) for writing on paper, and typed entry drops the spaces before decoding (coven has one spelling, format.md “As text”). Caption: “Print this code or save it in a password manager. It gets you back into your library if you lose all your devices.” then “It’s also in your iCloud Keychain.” on Apple, “A phone you set up from this one gets it too.” on Android (Block Store, coven §13.1); on S3 Android’s “You’ll also need your S3 access key and secret.” stays. Today Android calls it “recovery code” (recovery_code_title, RecoveryCodeSection.kt) and shows it ungrouped; macOS has no Show (RecoveryCodeRevealTests.swift). Print… (Print on Android) prints one page: the QR code, the grouped code, the provider and account as decode_code_info gives them (never the library's name, which can change: coven §13.1), the date, and how to use and keep it; the real code is about 250 characters. On S3 the printed code holds no access key. bae change, every locale.

setup-rules.text:
Set up sync:
macOS only, from Set up sync… on a library that isn't synced. The baeium edition offers S3 only, so it opens on the S3 form. Each step that waits says so: signing in in the browser, listing folders, then setup's own steps over a bar. When setup fails, its screen comes back with what was entered: the reason sits under the field it’s about, or at the top when it’s about no one field. Every screen has Cancel and no Back: Cancel takes you back one screen, and on Choose it closes the sheet. The sheet ends on the restore code, for every provider: bae can’t tell whether iCloud Keychain carries it off this Mac. Done lands on the Sync page, which reads Syncing… while the library uploads, then Synced, and holds the Restore code section.

Each provider's row below shows every step coven reports, in order, with the words bae shows. No step has a count, so the bar moves without filling.

storage-proposed.text: Proposed: the panel is this release only: its upload summary with Cancel, then one line per file. A dashed circle marks a queued file, a filling ring an uploading one; stored files show nothing. Pause for the whole sync queue moves to the window's footer.

storage-today.text: Today: Pause floats mid-header (a hidden Cancel All still holds its space). Bytes read Zero kB of Zero kB while 3 upload. A file with no audio format keeps an empty second line. A status chip adds a third line plus an invisible bar's height, so rows jump between three heights.

switch-rules.text: macOS keeps switching libraries from the main window's menu.

sync-rules.text:
How the sync states behave:
- coven gives the state; bae picks the words and the fix.
- When several hold, the first shows: Not synced, Removed from the library, Device needs reset, Update needed, Signed out, No access, Folder missing, Clock is wrong, Storage full, Offline · unsent changes, Offline, Sync failed, Syncing…, Waiting to sync, Synced.
- Not synced is macOS only: a phone joins a library and never makes one.
- Syncing… only while something is sent or received, not on quiet passes.
- Waiting to sync: online, with changes held back. Gray when uploads are paused or an upload waits to retry; amber when the provider asked bae to wait, saying when it resumes. Android never uploads files, so its only reason is the provider's wait.
- Synced means data and files both: a file still uploading is Syncing….
- Offline with changes waiting is Offline · unsent changes, with no count.
- Signed out names the provider and its sign-in: Dropbox and OneDrive sign in from bae; iCloud from System Settings. S3 has no sign-in: it reads Access key not accepted and asks for a new key for the same bucket. An expired sign-in reads the same as none saved.
- Sync failed: any failure with no state of its own, its cause in plain words, always with Retry now; it also retries by itself. A file that can't be uploaded (missing, or changed since import) names the file until it's back as it was; nothing skips it. Phones never upload, so their causes are local ones, a provider error or a damaged change.
- The Library page's Sync row shows the state only. The top of the Sync page shows the state, its cause and its fix, then Last synced under a problem state (never under Synced), then the storage details.
- Settings' Library row (Android) and the settings sidebar's Library item (macOS) show the state only when it's amber or red.
- No Sync stopped, no Checking sync… and no Disconnect anywhere.
- No raw ids on the Sync page: a row shows a name or isn't there.

transfers-rules.text:
Transfers:
no upload or download speed limits on any platform (CloudKit can't be paced). Android has no Pause uploads: a phone never uploads files. On macOS, while uploads or downloads are paused the sidebar shows an amber Paused beside Transfers, with ↑, ↓ or ⇅ for which.

welcome-rules.text:
Removing and deleting:
neither asks for device authentication. A library that was never synced offers Delete instead of Remove, on Android and macOS.

work-folder-name.text:
Folder (OneDrive, Dropbox):
coven records the picked folder's name and web address at setup, as labels only, never to reach storage. The Sync page shows Folder and Open in browser for those two; S3 and iCloud get neither.

work-history-off.text:
Listening history:
Off records no new plays; plays recorded before stay as they were. Everyone shares your plays with the library's people.

work-wifi-only.text:
Download over Wi-Fi only (Android), off by default:
while on, coven holds downloads and uploads on a metered network. coven watches the network itself. Playing a track that isn't pinned still streams.

Parts the screens are built from. Each screen that shows one imports it, so a change here shows everywhere.

shared-folderpicker-aligned.text: The new folder's name starts where the folder names above it start: the field's box sits 10px further left, so the text inside it lines up. Today the field and Create are an HStack in the Folders section (OAuthFolderSetup.swift:114-118). bae change.

code-invite.text:
What the code needs for the invite boards (refs are main as of Nov 6):
- The People list ends with the invite row: “Invite…” on macOS (today “Invite a person…”, MembersSection.swift:100), “Invite” with a + on Android (today a filled “Invite a person” button after the list, MembersScreen.kt:356, strings.xml:347). bae change.
- The form asks only what the storage shares with: their Dropbox, Microsoft or Apple Account email, or on S3 an access key, with a line saying why; on S3, Use my key instead (under the fields on Android, left of the footer on macOS) hands them your own key, saying that removing them later means a new key on each of your devices; then Create invite. No name, no role (everyone joins as Member), no in person or sent, a week to expire. Today: name, role, “Their account email” or keys, In person or Send, an expiry, “Create invitation” (InvitePersonSheet.swift, InviteDialog.kt). coven change (§13.2: the join request carries the name, not the invite; one kind of invite, always approved by comparing the number; confirm §14.3 lets two members share one S3 key), then bae; the spec's walk-through (spec/bae.md:2369) changes with it.
- The invite screen, titled Invite: while sharing, a bar and “Sharing the library with <email>…”; offline, that the code shows once this device is online; then one MacScanCode or AndroidScanCode: what to do, the QR code alone (no code text beside it), Copy code and Share, how long until it expires (“Expires in 7 days”, relative, as InviteCodeSheet.swift does today) and that the request shows up within seconds. The code has no such shared view yet: InviteCodeSheet.swift and InviteShownDialog.kt each lay out the QR code themselves. Today one spinner and “Sharing the library. The code shows once this library syncs.” online or not (InviteCodeSheet.swift:89, strings.xml:401); an in-person invite shows only the QR code, a sent one only the code; the title is the invitee's name. bae change.
- While the invite screen is open, the app asks sync to check every 5 seconds, as Add device does (bae-library/src/manager/people.rs, sync_often). Today nothing does for invites. bae change.
- An open invite's row: its email (its key on S3), Invited, and a chevron that opens its screen; Shares access once online while offline; Joining once approved. No refresh button: today “Check for requests” (MembersSection.swift:448, MembersScreen.kt InviteRow). bae change.
- Their request: “Approve request?”, then “<name> used your invite to <email>”, the number, Decline and Approve. Today the request sheet shows the invitee's name, “Confirmation number” and the number, Close, Decline, Approve (MembersSection.swift JoinRequestSheet). bae change.
- Cancel invite asks first: “Cancel this invite?” with Keep. Today the same confirmation with core's words (core.invite.cancel_confirm.*). Matches; words only.
- S3: the code screen also shows the key's ID and says to delete the key if nobody uses the invite (spec/bae.md:2412). Built (InviteCodeSheet.swift keyLine); not drawn yet.
- A sharing failure a retry can't fix (no such account, say) ends the invite by itself, as a failed request check does (coven spec §13.2). Its row becomes a notice, “Couldn’t invite: Dropbox has no account for it”, with Dismiss; there is no failed screen to cancel from. A failure a retry can fix keeps retrying, the invite still Sharing. Today the invite stays open with coven's held reason, in its row and screen, until it is cancelled (InviteCodeSheet.swift:80, MembersSection.swift InviteRow). coven change (end the invite on a permanent sharing failure, keeping why for the app), then bae.
- Queued: plans/invites.md; coven in todo.md §2 #214 (one kind of invite, the name in the request, a permanent sharing failure ends the invite, two members on one S3 key), bae in #215 after the coven pin bump.

code-playback.text:
